parts.quote: Give me an overview of this week: what's on, the open tasks and the shopping list.

answers.text: This week features Swim training (Ellie) on Tuesday, October 6; Early shift (Lukas), Client meeting (Sofia), Piano lesson (Ellie), Football training (Noah), and Work dinner (Lukas) on Wednesday, October 7; Dentist checkup (Noah) and Swimming (Noah) on Thursday, October 8; and Sunday planning on Sunday, October 11. Open tasks are buying a birthday present for Mila and booking the car service, and the shopping list includes Bread, Cheddar, Tomatoes, Pasta, and Eggs.
